Comment: Migrate4HANA BAPI / in-place pipeline. Fans out per-object loads through the data-migrator lambda's UnifiedLoader -> 25-spine roster path, then reconciles each result via Reconciler.reconcile against live S/4 SoR tables (MARA / BUT000 / EKKO / VBAK / BSID / BSIK / etc.). For BAPI/in-place customers; separate from the lift-and-shift state machine which routes via MC/LTMOM/IDOC handlers.

Stage0_PrepareRun.Comment: Normalize the caller payload into the per-object iteration shape the DistributedMap expects.

Stage1_FanOutSpineLoads.Comment: Parallel per-object loads. Each invocation drives UnifiedLoader.load_object(obj, rows, max_rows) which routes through the spine registry (25 promoted objects) and emits verify_key dicts the Reconciler can consume.

Stage2_AggregateReconciliation.Comment: Aggregate per-object reconciler reports. Each iterator result already carries the reconciler verdict from _phase_b_validate_production_path (status=RECONCILED / DISCREPANCY / VALUE_DISCREPANCY / NOT_VERIFIABLE / NO_LOAD).

Stage3_VerdictGate.Comment: Binary gate: any per-object result.reconciler_report.status != RECONCILED routes to a manual review. Conservative default; can be relaxed per customer SLA.

ManualReviewBlock.Cause: BAPI in-place pipeline: at least one object reconciler reported a discrepancy. Inspect per_object[*].reconciler_report.by_table for the gap.

MigrationComplete.Comment: All objects loaded via the spine path AND reconciled against live target SoR. Run audit-ledger captures the per-object verify_key tie-out.
